spec:
Found while dogfooding Release 1 (dogfood notes 62, 73, 74, 75). A finding is live only while its target's latest record is done and current, so:
- After a node blocks (an owner question) or goes stale (an input changed), its re-run card shows `corrections: []` although findings against it are still open; answering them is refused with "no live finding ... Findings arrived while you ran", which is wrong. The root relayed findings to workers by hand several times.
- A second, different run_tests failure reuses the id `run_tests:failed` and is treated as a repeat, raising a needs_human dispute that says implement answered '' although it had answered "fixed: ...".

Owner decision (verbatim): "3. Ok" (to carrying open findings onto the re-run's card and accepting answers to them), and "I think we may as well get these done now, before dogfooding again".

Scope:
- A re-run card of a stale or blocked node lists the open findings against that node as corrections, and submit accepts responses to them.
- A refusal for a finding that is no longer live says why (resolved, superseded, target changed) and to drop it, instead of "arrived while you ran".
- A new run_tests failure with different text is a new round, not a repeat; a dispute question shows the target's actual last response.
- Check this against G1026's option (b) (owner questions resolved by the re-review) and keep that flow working.

Acceptance:
- Replays of the G1026 cases (review_tests findings on test_design, then a design change staling test_design) show the findings on the stale card and accept fixed: responses.
- Two different run_tests failures in a row give two rounds and no dispute.
- This PR edits docs/design/SPEC.md and DESIGN.md for every contract change it makes and adds a HISTORY §4 row.
title: Carry open findings onto stale and blocked re-run cards
